551:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But the fact is, they're not here...」

551:t_021:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That very possibility is the only one I can think of.」

551:t_021:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ must have teleported somewhere, system and all.」

551:t_022:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain! We have a call from Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch!」

551:t_022:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「A unit believed to be $$アマルガム$$ has suddenly appeared at the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$, he says!」

551:t_022:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ and $$レナード$$ are there...」

551:t_022:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Contact $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$ラー・カイラム$$! $c will rendezvous in $$相模湾$$!」

551:t_022:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「From there we'll head for the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$ and stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s ambition!」

551:t_023:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How about that, Sis! Perfect combination, wasn't it!」

551:t_023:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even on the battlefield, we're one body and one soul!」

551:t_023:3.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm acting like a little girl... Now of all times, I've started to value my life...)

551:t_023:4.en:
$$マオ$$
(If that idiot is alive, then I want to live too. In this world...)

551:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
($$クルツ$$, Lieutenant $$サックス$$... Watch over me...)

551:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(We'll definitely do it...! I won't let him have his way with this world!)

551:t_101:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I've been feeling something off for a while now...)

551:t_101:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(What is this...? Am I... overlooking something...)

551:t_102:1.en:
$$マオ$$
(A world without you is meaningless... So I'm going to fight here... prepared to throw this life away...!)

551:t_103:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
($$ウェーバー$$... Losing you was the responsibility of me, your superior...)

551:t_103:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(Let's do this...! Sorry, but we will win without fail, even if it disappoints you!)

uncertain: 551:t_103:1: source reads 'to disappoint you' (がっかりさせるために), probably a script slip for 'not to disappoint'; rendered literally as 'Sorry, but we will win without fail, even if it disappoints you'.
551:t_022:1: reported speech, rendered '...he says' (Otsuka, male per glossary).
大塚長官 = 'Director Otsuka' (guess; 長官 not in settled list); 極東支部 = 'Far East Branch'.
